name: CyberOne
summary:
CyberOne is Xiaomi’s earlier full-size bipedal humanoid research platform. Xiaomi lists a height of 177 cm, mass of 52 kg and 21 degrees of freedom. Its motion system combines integrated joint modules with whole-body control; the published maximum speed is 3.6 km/h.

The platform uses Xiaomi’s Mi Sense depth-vision module for spatial perception, microphones for voice and environmental-sound recognition, and a curved OLED face display for interaction. It explores locomotion, perception and human–robot interaction. This record is distinct from the humanoids Xiaomi demonstrated in 2026.
